title: Polish Velvety Fondue
description: A rich and creamy Polish-inspired fondue perfect for dipping bread or vegetables. Rich in calories and indulgent in flavor.
instructions: Combine Polish Sugar and Fondue in a medium saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until the sugar dissolves.
Remove from heat and stir in the Rich Whipping Cream until well combined.
Add the Fondue Cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Transfer the fondue to a serving bowl and serve immediately.
Arrange bread or vegetables on a platter and serve with the fondue for dipping.
